purpose: Pre-registered equal-k reference-composition mechanism ablation following frozen external validation. This is explanatory benchmarking, not model tuning.
combination_rule: For a development target evaluate every 2-of-4 subset of the remaining development species; for an external target evaluate every 2-of-5 subset of the five development species. Combinations follow source_order lexicographically.
representation: Exact Phase 12 / frozen external-linear multicopy representation: take the top 256 raw input genes per cell and then map their genes to the frozen 19968-orthogroup vocabulary with binary collapse. Phase 16 reuses the original rank_to_orthogroup implementation and frozen mappings; no count-aggregated alternative representation is used.
matching_rule: For each seed, development source cells first follow the frozen Phase 12 label-stratified source sampling rule. Within each target and seed, form one source-only common class vocabulary by intersecting the pooled class vocabularies of every predeclared equal-k combination. Filter every source to this vocabulary. Set one per-source quota equal to the smallest filtered source-cell count among all candidate source species, then draw one fixed source-specific sample reused in every combination. Thus all combinations have exactly k sources, equal cells from each source, the same total training budget, common source classes, identical source draws whenever a source recurs, and identical target query cells.
inductive_policy: No target expression or label is used to select combinations, classes, quotas, features, sampling, model parameters, or stopping decisions. All target predictions are saved and SHA256-hashed before the scoring aggregation opens any target labels.
target_evaluation_rule: Development targets are predicted on all cells blindly, then after prediction hashing scored only on the exact frozen Phase 12 per-seed label-stratified max_cells subset using seed + 1009*manifest_train_order. External targets are predicted and scored on all mapped-label cells. In all cases the final evaluated cells are further restricted to the source-only common class vocabulary.
primary_endpoint: Macro-F1 for each target-seed-reference-pair observation; balanced accuracy is secondary.
mechanism_model: Ordinary least squares: Macro-F1 ~ reference_pairwise_breadth + mean_target_distance + mean_family_species_support + target fixed effects + seed fixed effects. Associations are explanatory, not causal estimates.
uncertainty: 1000 target-and-seed blocked bootstrap resamples of the complete combination rows; report percentile 95% CIs for mechanism coefficients. Family-level mechanism summaries exclude target-family rows with zero evaluable support.
external_direction_gate: For each external target, average Macro-F1 over the five fixed seeds within each reference pair and calculate the within-target Spearman association with reference_pairwise_breadth. The equal-k=2 external direction gate passes only when both Sorghum bicolor and Catharanthus roseus have a strictly positive association. This descriptive gate does not replace the already completed all_sources versus nearest_clade validation.
stop_rule: Exactly the five fixed linear seeds, exhaustive equal-k=2 combinations, and no new model, tuning, source set, target, or seed after outcomes are observed.
interpretation_rule: Use results to decompose the already observed broad-reference advantage; do not claim a new predictive method from this phase.
